item.title: Repairs and maintenance long overdue, 28th July
item.description:
The see saw has been out of service for months and barricaded off with barriers that are all over the place. The original roundabout is rickety, unsafe, loud and heavy for young kids. Surely overdue a replacement of something else? A play space doesn’t need two roundabouts. The swing seats have cracks in them and are old. The whole place needs a revamp and some money splashed on it. I’ve been using it for two years and the grass is either too long for toddlers, there’s no path through the gate from the park into the play area so it’s not stable for little walkers. Especially with the stinging nettles coming out of the neighbours bushes. It just needs some love in there it’s really unloved and forgotten.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Stanton Close, Poverest, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Light Intrusion - causing light nuisance, 28th July
item.description:
A new LED street light was installed over a month ago. Since installation, it has been shining directly into my bedroom every night. Unlike the other street lights on the road, this one has no shield/cover even though it’s 20x brighter than any of the street lights, to direct the light away from nearby properties. Even with my shutter closed, the light still enters my room and reaches my bed, significantly disrupting my sleep. Please inspect the installation and fit a suitable shield/deflector so the light is directed onto the road rather than into my bedroom. If possible, I would also appreciate the brightness being reduced and the cover being added, thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Wharton Road, Plaistow, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Illegal deposits of dog waste/ faeces on a daily basis -99 Fenham Rd, SE15 1AE, 28th July
item.description:
Illegal deposits of dog wastes in black bags in an overflowing green bin- attracting swarms of flies and contaminating the whole area with an obnoxious fumes. This is causing swarms of flies in the neighbouring homes and causing serious irritation and uncomfortable living conditions where residents are unable to open their doors and windows - to keep the stink fumes and flies out. It has been noted there are a series of dogs trained at this address, these dogs are houling and consistent barking of these dogs which causes stress and discomfort at different times of the days. Several neighbours have complained about the dogs and the uncomfortable smell which comes out from this particular home. This individual according to the council sanitation requirements is operating a dog training business without a license in this residential area. I need your urgent support in this manner, for the benefit of the entire community.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 99, Fenham Road, Peckham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
